findings.detail: Failure is announced outside the modal; editor has no visible save-status or retry control.
Creating a named new role retains Linzhou identity, dialogue examples, and knowledge.
Undo history survives Apply; first Undo recreates pre-apply content as an unapplied draft without explaining the boundary.
Missing-title error returns only to the knowledge list; does not open/focus the offending document.
Preview still displays scenes[0] after setting a different scene as default.
The normal Apply review exposes manifest filename/raw diff instead of the changed document title.
